game.name: SILENT HILL 2 (2024 remake)
game.engine_evidence: 5.1.1-0+++UE5+Release-5.1, read from the crash context of the first launch [measured 2026-09-19]

notes: Extended keys (arrows, nav cluster) need KEYEVENTF_EXTENDEDKEY or scancode 0x50 arrives as numpad-2 and the menu silently ignores it.
Foreground the window before sending input and re-check that it took; synthetic input follows focus.
Enter (scancode 0x1C) dismisses the content-warning screen. [verified-live 2026-09-19, n=1]

window.how_to_window: Edit %LOCALAPPDATA%\SilentHill2\Saved\Config\Windows\GameUserSettings.ini with the game CLOSED (the engine rewrites config on exit).
window.warning: All three resolution key pairs must agree. Setting only one does not take.
window.no_ingame_countdown_needed: The config route avoids the in-game 'keep these settings?' timer entirely, which is what reverts unattended runs.

states.what: Steam's 'Grab a controller and kick back!' modal, shown on a first launch only. One OK button.
Black screen, game logo, content warning text, 'PRESS ANY BUTTON TO CONTINUE'
CONTINUE / NEW GAME / LOAD GAME / SETTINGS / CREDITS / EXIT, over a living-room scene

steps: dismiss the Steam controller prompt if it appears (first launch only)
wait: about 2-3 minutes on the dev PC, most of it shader/PSO compilation
Enter to clear the content warning

uevr_overlay.confidence: inferred-static 2026-09-19, read from UEVR's own config

hazards.what: On the main menu CONTINUE is highlighted by default and NEW GAME is the very next item down. The account's save has 97 hours on it.
hazards.rule: Never blind key-count downward on this menu. Navigate, capture, verify the highlight, only then commit.
hazards.related: same family as Enslaved's NEW JOURNEY trap

hazards.what: LowLevelFatalError RenderingThread.cpp:1273 'GameThread timed out waiting for RenderThread after 120.00 secs' on shipped defaults (1920x1080, all quality 3, Raytracing=On).
hazards.rule: It is a TIMEOUT, not a renderer fault. Lower the settings AND raise g.TimeoutForBlockOnRenderFence in Engine.ini [ConsoleVariables]. Do not read it as a broken install.

hazards.what: UEVR logs 'Hooked DirectX 12', then 121 consecutive 'Failed to initialize Framework on DirectX 12' over ~2 seconds, and then 'Framework initialized'.
hazards.rule: Those are retries. The injection succeeded. Reading the log cold would suggest otherwise.

hazards.what: FindWindow(null, "Silent Hill 2") does not match this game's window even though the title reads exactly that.
hazards.rule: Take the handle from the process instead (Get-Process ... MainWindowHandle).

notes: Screen capture: use BitBlt from the screen DC, never PrintWindow - PrintWindow silently serves a stale DWM-cached frame the moment the game stops presenting.
The injector (UEVR) is a WPF GUI with no command line; it has to be driven visually. Its window can start hidden behind the game - foreground it via the taskbar.
The game appears in UEVR's process list WITHOUT administrator rights, so no UAC prompt is needed for an unattended run [verified-live 2026-09-19, n=1].
Dev PC is far below this game's minimum spec (i7-3770S, GTX 1660 SUPER). No frame rate measured here means anything.
